name: GCB
recent: Guan Chong 在 2026 年 8 月公布季度业绩，营收同比下滑但净利大幅增长，并宣布第三次中期股息每股 2.5 仙。公司持续有凭单 C 转换新股上市，大股东 Guan Chong Resources 多次申报股权变动。管理层在 9 月表示 El Niño 可能导致全球可可供应短缺。
notable: 宣布第三次中期股息每股 2.5 仙，除息日 2026 年 9 月 9 日，派发日 9 月 25 日。
凭单 C 转换新股分两批上市，分别于 2026 年 9 月 7 日和 9 月 21 日。
管理层表示 El Niño 可能导致全球可可供应短缺。
risks: 大股东 Guan Chong Resources 在 2026 年 9 月至 11 月间多次申报股权变动。
董事在闭门期内有交易意向的申报。
凭单 C 持续转换新股，可能逐步稀释现有股东权益。
earnings: 2026 年第二季营收为 MYR 1,803.7 百万，环比下降 31.2%，同比下降 53.6%；净利为 MYR 253.0 百万，环比增长 104.8%，同比增长 424.9%；净利率为 14.0%，高于上一季度的 4.7%。

recent_en: Guan Chong reported quarterly results in August 2026 with lower revenue but significantly higher net profit, and declared a third interim dividend of 2.5 sen per share. The company continued to see new shares listed from Warrant C conversions, while substantial shareholder Guan Chong Resources filed multiple changes in interest. Management said in September that El Niño could lead to a global cocoa supply deficit.
notable_en: Declared a third interim dividend of 2.5 sen per share, with ex-date on 9 September 2026 and payment date on 25 September 2026.
New shares from Warrant C conversions were listed in two batches on 7 September and 21 September 2026.
Management said El Niño could lead to a global cocoa supply deficit.
risks_en: Substantial shareholder Guan Chong Resources filed multiple changes in interest between September and November 2026.
Directors filed notices of intention to deal during the closed period.
Ongoing Warrant C conversions may gradually dilute existing shareholders' equity.
earnings_en: For 2Q 2026, revenue was MYR 1,803.7 million, down 31.2% QoQ and 53.6% YoY; net profit was MYR 253.0 million, up 104.8% QoQ and 424.9% YoY; net margin was 14.0%, higher than 4.7% in the previous quarter.
